preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or authorized address (owner, MarketingWallet, or Developer)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner or authorized address, call the UpdateTaxes function to set buyTax to a value higher than MaxTax (20). For example, call UpdateTaxes(10, 10, 10, 10, 10, 50, 25, 10, 15) where buyTax=25 exceeds the MaxTax limit. This demonstrates the owner can bypass the reasonable fee limit constraint.
